risks.proof: Short video: plug-in, compressor running, and a thermometer reading after cooling.

risks.risk: Voltage compatibility for Rivers power not proven (could require stabilizer).

risks.if_unproven: Price as reduced performance (worst-case: gasket leak/poor retention).

risks.risk: Brand/model not readable; wrong identity can misprice the unit.
risks.proof: Clear photo of brand/model nameplate (usually side/back/inside lid frame).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the rating plate/spec label (brand, model, capacity in liters, and voltage range).
Send a short video of it running (compressor sound/indicator) and a thermometer reading after it cools.
Send photos of the receipt and warranty card (showing date/serial number).
Send a close-up photo of the door gasket/inner lid seal area.
